AC-01.01.test_name: Gradle Android project configuration and debug assembly
AC-01.01.actual_result: Actual Gradle configuration, resource processing and assembleDebug completed; a debug APK exists. This establishes the debug project baseline, not all architecture or release gates.
AC-01.01.corrective_action: Complete signed-release, lint and device gates separately.

AC-01.02.actual_result: Actual compileDebugKotlin and compileDebugJavaWithJavac tasks completed and assembleDebug produced the APK. A deprecated icon API warning remains; no compile error is recorded. Pending later lint/device tasks are not reported as passed.
AC-01.02.corrective_action: Resolve warnings and complete remaining checks without treating compilation as release approval.

AC-01.03.test_name: Debug APK generation and artifact snapshot
AC-01.03.actual_result: assembleDebug generated app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk (13,752,583 bytes at the inspected snapshot). SHA-256 was recorded; the primary agent installed and launched this debug build on a physical API-28 Fire tablet.
AC-01.03.corrective_action: Keep the APK hash associated with this build evidence; verify the signed release independently.

AC-01.04.actual_result: The release signing process is documented and configured from environment variables, but no verified publisher-signed release is recorded. A debug APK is not submission evidence.
AC-01.04.corrective_action: Provision the publisher's private signing material securely, build the release and verify its certificate.

AC-01.06.test_name: Mandatory Google service dependency declaration audit
AC-01.06.environment: Static source and Gradle dependency declaration inspection
AC-01.06.actual_result: Executed source/configuration audit reports no Google Play Services or Google Play Billing dependency declared; the app uses native Amazon Appstore SDK. This is a declaration audit, not a full transitive supply-chain or network analysis.
AC-01.06.corrective_action: Recheck resolved release dependencies and runtime behaviour before submission.

AC-01.07.environment: Static source/configuration scan; no release APK secret audit performed
AC-01.07.actual_result: Executed static audit found no recognised API-key/password/signing-secret patterns and no app authentication key checked into source. Signing values are read from environment variables. This pass is limited to the executed source pattern/configuration check and is not a guarantee against arbitrary secrets or a release-artifact security approval.
AC-01.07.corrective_action: Perform the separate release-artifact and full privacy/security checks; keep developer credentials external.

AC-04.08.test_name: Calendar-day recurrence and Europe/London DST unit cases
AC-04.08.actual_result: recurrenceCrossesLeapDayAndYear and reminderKeepsLocalMorningAcrossDaylightSaving passed. The tested helper keeps 09:00 local across the London spring DST transition with a 23-hour elapsed interval. This unit result covers date/helper semantics, not real WorkManager delivery, all timezones or device timezone-change events.
AC-04.08.corrective_action: Execute device notification/timezone-change and further zone-boundary scenarios separately.

AC-19.01.actual_result: Only the debug APK generation is verified in this observation update; no publisher-signed release artifact is verified.
AC-19.01.corrective_action: Complete signed release generation and retain certificate/build evidence.
